The Goddess of the Moon was believed to govern cycles of growth and change and was honored for her nurturing and protective qualities. This name can be seen as a reminder of the ever-changing cycles of life and the power of the divine in guiding us through life's corridors. For parents seeking to give their child a name with a profound spiritual meaning, Lunaria is an option packed with symbolism and rich historical significance.

historical_references.reference: Lunaria, the Roman goddess of the Moon, was often identified with the Greek goddess Selene. Both were associated with the cycles of the moon and the changing of the seasons.
